descriptionChirho: Gentilic adjective denoting a person from Gilead, the Transjordanian region east of the Jordan River. Applied to individuals such as Jephthah (Judg 11:1,40; 12:7) and Barzillai (2 Sam 17:27; 19:31-32; 1 Kgs 2:7; Ezra 2:61; Neh 7:63). Both singular (eng: the-Gileadite, spa: el-galaadita, hin: गिलादी, arb: الْجِلْعَادِيِّ, kor: 길르앗사람, swa: Mgileadi) and plural forms (eng: Gileadites, spa: galaaditas, hin: गिलअदीम, arb: جِلْعَادَ, swa: Wgileadi) share the same gentilic meaning.
